policy: Evidence ranges are not automatic prescriptions. Safety, product composition, population and indication must be verified before activation.
supported_context: selected endurance and intermittent high-intensity exercise

protocols.amount: 400 mg/day total caffeine reference for many healthy adults, not a target or universally safe limit

personalization: Body mass informs studied mg/kg exposures; count coffee, energy drinks, pre-workout and other caffeine; consider sleep, sensitivity and timing.
safety: children/adolescents and pregnancy require distinct policies
cardiovascular symptoms, anxiety, insomnia, interacting drugs -> review
high doses add risk without reliable extra benefit
next_review: Determine conservative evidence-based candidate selection within studied ranges; verify population exclusions and total daily exposure.
